description.text: Built in 1897 by renowned architect Jarvis Hunt, the House of Seven Gables stands as one of Wheaton's most iconic residences. Commissioned as a wedding gift by Chicago steel magnate Jay Morse, the home was part of an exclusive enclave of summer estates near the Chicago Golf Club. With its grand Tudor facade, hand-carved woodwork, and seven distinctive gables, the home embodies the craftsmanship and elegance of the Gilded Age. Later known as the Loretto Convent, the mansion became a treasured local landmark. When its future was threatened by redevelopment, preservationists rallied to save it. In 2017, the entire 10,000-square-foot, 730-ton structure was skillfully relocated 500 feet and placed on a new foundation -- an engineering feat that captured regional attention and ensured the home's next chapter. Today, the House of Seven Gables offers a remarkable opportunity. The heavy lifting is complete, with structural work, modern infrastructure, all-new mechanicals, including zoned central heating and air conditioning, and public utilities. A newly built, attached three-car garage offers modern convenience, while the unfinished lower level, with 10-foot ceilings, provides endless potential for a recreation area, home gym, theater, wine cellar, or anything you envision. Set on a generous lot that backs up to Seven Gables Park, a 66.5-acre recreational destination, the property offers multiple outdoor spaces for relaxation and entertaining. Enjoy direct access to sports fields, tennis courts, an ice rink, and scenic walking trails-perfect for those who value an active, outdoor lifestyle. Located in the sought-after Whittier School district, part of Wheaton District 200, this home offers not only historic significance but everyday livability in a vibrant community. The foundation is laid, both literally and figuratively, for the next chapter. This architectural treasure is ready for its new steward to complete the vision and make it truly their own.

description.text: A quiet pastoral setting on over an acre of manicured grounds, this architecturally correct 4-bedroom, 4.1 bath Wheaton home, is a neo-classical work of art! Inspired by the homeowner, a Wheaton history aficionado and craftsman, this beauty combines historical details from a series of houses surrounding the Chicago Golf Club, designed by noted architect Jarvis Hunt the nephew of famed Richard Morris Hunt of the Biltmore Estate in Asheville, North Carolina. The goal was to create a new house that looked as if it were built at the turn to the 19th century. This masterpiece incorporates many architectural pieces, some from historically significant and prominent Wheaton homes. Manufactured reproduction items were also carefully sourced such as custom milled woodwork, cabinetry and doors, solid brass hardware, push-button light switches, authentic register covers, garage doors made to look like carriage doors, historical paint colors and authentic wallpapers including William Morris reproductions. The wood casings, base and crown, taken from a vintage design was custom milled out of poplar by Paxton Lumber. Every window, hand built in Oregon by Bergerson Windows is made from western red cedar, which will never deteriorate and features a weight and pulley system. The main entry welcomes with the cherry staircase by Adams Stair, ascending three stories has carved rosettes and beading...also seen in other Hunt homes. Ahead to the gracious formal dining room or the formal living room to the right, you'll find elegant and perfected detailing including the hand painted mural, period lighting and more. From either set of living room French doors, walk out to the covered porch offering beautiful sunsets and serene views of the grounds and surrounding naturalized areas. The custom kitchen features Kennebec cabinetry, handcrafted in Bath, Maine, wide planked pine flooring and center island table and is equipped with modern stainless appliances and soapstone counters without giving up the look of an historic home. Adjacent to the kitchen and breakfast room is the family room, reminiscent of an English hunting lodge with its barrel-vaulted ceiling, stone fireplace and built-in bookcase. French doors lead to the bluestone patio and extensive gardens by noted landscape architect Anthony Tyznik. Descend either main or back staircase to the masterfully finished basement and find one amazing Arts & Crafts style, fully finished dream. From the clinker brick fireplace, quartersawn oak millwork and doors to the built-ins and Bradbury and Bradbury hand silk-screened wallpaper the inviting recreation space with covered porch walk-out, kitchen area with sink and refrigerator, full bath, wine room, workshop and more have been done to perfection! The second and 3rd floors are elegantly appointed with 4+ bedrooms and 3 full baths. Bedroom four is currently set up and used as a craft room with counter and sink. The primary suite of rooms features a screened sleeping porch, private bath with double sink vanity and oversized shower, generous walk-in closet with doorway to nursery or bedroom two. This spectacular offering, although only twenty-five years young, live and feels like an award worthy historic residence. The close-knit neighborhood with the feeling of country living is not found in many suburban settings. With a convenient location, near schools, Atten Park, Cantigny Junior and Senior Golf and Mansion, St. James Farm, plus shopping and restaurants of South Wheaton.

description.text: Originally built by a custom home builder as his personal residence, 1045 Linda Lane exudes charm and showcases many perks throughout! This one of a kind 2 story home located on a corner lot featuring a dreamy wrap around front porch, boasts 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, Anderson windows & doors, ample living space on the main floor, a private entrance into what could be an office/flex/dining space, a generous side yard, partially finished basement, & so much more! Imagine enjoying your morning coffee or evening cocktail on your new front porch, and soaking in the good life in the sought after Lake Holiday community - Does it get any better? Let's step inside and find out - upon entry, you'll be greeted by an oak staircase to your left leading to the 2nd level, a convenient coat closet, and a sun drenched front room that could serve a multitude of purposes! Also nearby is a main floor 1/2 bath. Just off the front room is a flex space/office/dining room option with hardwood floors, a bay window, and its own private entrance out onto the wraparound porch. Next up, is the spacious eat-in kitchen with ample storage and great sight lines to the dining area, and the main fireside living room. The kitchen showcases SS appliances, stylish stainless steel floating shelves, breakfast bar seating, table space, as well as a long coffee bar/extra storage. Off the kitchen via the sliding glass door, is a sprawling 12x43 rear deck w/ added privacy and a nearby 220amp outlet for a hot tub! The living room is home to a fireplace encased by two built in bookcases and features gas logs for cozy evenings in! Off the living room is an expansive laundry room w/ an adjacent walk-in pantry, deep utility sink, built in drop down iron board with electric, & storage cabinets, and access to the exterior side yard as well as the attached 2 car garage. Heading upstairs, (Be sure to take note of the BRAND NEW carpeting!) the first of 4 bedrooms has a staircase that leads up to unfinished attic space (approx 15x30) that could easily be finished off to be something unique and added SF! The other 2 guest bedrooms are ideal in size, and near the first full bath complete with a tub/shower combo. At the end of the hall, you'll find a linen closet and entrance to the primary suite w/ great light coming in through the windows, a large closet within the room, and a secondary closet within the primary en suite that boasts 2 separate vanities, one with added space for a make-up seat, and a door to close off the toilet, tub/shower, and 2nd vanity for extra privacy! Last but not least, let's head down to the basement - a partially finished rec room, large storage room, and partial crawl complete the home! MANY improvements have been done over the years, including; New A/C (2021), New furnace (2020), Hot water heater (2017), roof, gutters, gutter guards, some exterior doors, attic fan & vents, attic windows (2012), brand new carpet upstairs with a lifetime warranty (2025), LVT floors in the primary en suite (approx 2yo), microwave (2020), & more! "Be On Vacation Every Day of the Year" at 1045 Linda Lane!
